classes.name: Hepatitis C direct-acting antivirals
classes.description: Sofosbuvir/velpatasvir (Epclusa and authorized generic), glecaprevir/pibrentasvir (Mavyret), ledipasvir/sofosbuvir (Harvoni and authorized generic), sofosbuvir/velpatasvir/voxilaprevir (Vosevi), elbasvir/grazoprevir (Zepatier).
classes.plainDescription: An 8 to 12 week course of pills that cures hepatitis C.

preferredAgent.strength: 400 mg/100 mg tablet (label strength; MHDL does not print strength)
preferredAgent.plainSig: One pill a day for 12 weeks.

records.preferredRestriction: PA required (MHDL HCV PA form paId 14). Sofosbuvir/velpatasvir for 12 weeks is a preferred regimen in the MHDL Single Agents grid for GT1 naive non-cirrhotic (and other genotypes listed)
records.tier: MHDL: PD (preferred drug marker), PA required

criteria: Treatment-naive, with or without compensated cirrhosis (including post-transplant): diagnosis of hepatitis C, genotype 1-6.
Treatment-experienced (interferon, ribavirin, or sofosbuvir-based only), with or without compensated cirrhosis: genotype 1-6 plus fibrosis staging records (FIB-4, etc.) showing F0-F4 or cirrhosis.
Genotype 1 after failure of sofosbuvir plus simeprevir, a protease inhibitor regimen, or an NS5A inhibitor: fibrosis staging records (FIB-4, etc.) showing F0-F4 or cirrhosis.
Prior Mavyret or Vosevi failure: regimen of glecaprevir/pibrentasvir plus sofosbuvir and ribavirin, fibrosis staging records (FIB-4, etc.), and no decompensated cirrhosis.

Treatment-naive, no cirrhosis (genotype 1, 4, 5, 6): fibrosis staging records (FIB-4, etc.) at F0-F3; genotype 1 viral load 6 million IU/mL or higher, or genotype 4-6 adults: rationale vs sofosbuvir/velpatasvir.

Treatment-naive with compensated cirrhosis, or experienced (interferon, protease inhibitor) without cirrhosis: fibrosis staging records (FIB-4, etc.); adults need rationale for use instead of sofosbuvir/velpatasvir.

Treatment-experienced with compensated cirrhosis: fibrosis staging records (FIB-4, etc.) and rationale vs sofosbuvir/velpatasvir (adults); genotype 1 adults add ribavirin or give rationale for 24 weeks without it.

Decompensated cirrhosis (CTP B or C): rationale vs sofosbuvir/velpatasvir, not post liver or kidney transplant, fibrosis staging records (FIB-4, etc.), and a ribavirin-containing regimen (or ribavirin contraindicated).
Failed an NS5A inhibitor (genotype 1-6, with or without compensated cirrhosis): fibrosis staging records (FIB-4, etc.); genotype 3 with compensated cirrhosis needs ribavirin.
Failed sofosbuvir without an NS5A inhibitor (genotype 1a or 3): fibrosis staging records (FIB-4, etc.).

Prior Mavyret or Vosevi failure: fibrosis staging records (FIB-4, etc.), no decompensated cirrhosis; after Vosevi or Mavyret plus Sovaldi failure, ribavirin and rationale vs Mavyret plus Sovaldi plus ribavirin.

Post liver or kidney transplant after sofosbuvir or NS5A failure: fibrosis staging records (FIB-4, etc.); ribavirin if compensated cirrhosis; genotype 1 or 3 after sofosbuvir-only failure needs rationale vs Mavyret.
Genotype 1 or 4: contraindication to all combination products FDA-approved for that genotype (treatment-naive, or failed peginterferon and ribavirin only for genotype 1).
Fibrosis staging records (FIB-4, etc.) showing F0-F4, and no decompensated cirrhosis.
Genotype 1a: NS5A resistance testing at positions 28, 30, 31, 93; if substitutions are present, a ribavirin-containing regimen.
After a protease inhibitor plus peginterferon and ribavirin (genotype 1): ribavirin-containing regimen required.

records.stepTherapy: PA criteria vary by genotype, treatment history and cirrhosis status (MHDL Table 44 Single Agents grid). The grid lists Mavyret, ledipasvir/sofosbuvir and sofosbuvir/velpatasvir as preferred regimens for GT1 naive non-cirrhotic patients.
records.verificationNote: Read MHDL Table 44 directly. All five DAA products carry PA (form 14). The Single Agents grid names the preferred regimens by genotype. Epclusa chosen as the preferred pick (taxonomy names the authorized generic; the MHDL row lists the generic name sofosbuvir/velpatasvir). No covered DAA without PA exists in this table. [Sonnet check 2026-10-22: Table 44 marks Epclusa, Mavyret and Harvoni all PD; every DAA still carries PA (PA form 14).] [2026-10-22 review: sig replaced with label dosing by indication/titration.]
preferredCriteria: Treatment-naive, with or without compensated cirrhosis: diagnosis of hepatitis C, genotype 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6.
Treatment-experienced (failed peginterferon and ribavirin): genotype 1-6 plus fibrosis staging records (FIB-4, etc.); adult genotype 3 also needs Y93H testing, with ribavirin if Y93H or cirrhosis.
Decompensated cirrhosis (CTP B or C), not post liver or kidney transplant: fibrosis staging records (FIB-4, etc.) and a ribavirin-containing regimen (or ribavirin contraindicated or not tolerated).
Post liver or kidney transplant: genotype 1-6 with fibrosis staging records (FIB-4, etc.); with decompensated cirrhosis after liver transplant, ribavirin is required.
